title: minuartia geniculata var. poiretiana
intro: Minuartia geniculata var. poiretiana, commonly known as Alpine Spring Beauty or Alpine Stitchwort, is a plant species in the pink family (Caryophyllaceae) characterized by its delicate white flowers. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Minuartia geniculata var. poiretiana include astringent and hemostatic effects, making it useful in treating minor cuts and abrasions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
